quotes.text: Holding delete for message opened in a standalone message window still shows the issue.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: For Delete and macOS Backspace message commands, ignore event.repeat before dispatch so holding one key cannot delete successive messages. Cover three-pane and loaded about:message documents, including standalone windows. D212650 review found the initial three-pane-only fix incomplete. Later bug 1911946 confirms protection is intended; bulk deletion uses explicit selection. Do not suppress navigation or all repeated keys. Commits 272/274 added no automated test; current source retains both guards.
title: Message deletion ignores held-key repeats on every message surface
